component.name: TcpTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "execute" end sub
sub execute() print "TASK: start" port = CreateObject("roMessagePort")
listenAddr = CreateObject("roSocketAddress") listenAddr.setAddress("127.0.0.1:0") listener = CreateObject("roStreamSocket") listener.setMessagePort(port) listener.setAddress(listenAddr) listener.notifyReadable(true) listening = listener.listen(4) boundPort = listenAddr.getPort() print "TASK: listening="; listening; " port="; boundPort
client = CreateObject("roStreamSocket") client.setMessagePort(port) client.notifyReadable(true) clientAddr = CreateObject("roSocketAddress") clientAddr.setAddress("127.0.0.1:" + boundPort.toStr()) client.setSendToAddress(clientAddr) connected = client.connect() print "TASK: connected="; connected
result = "timeout" accepted = invalid timespan = CreateObject("roTimespan") while timespan.TotalMilliseconds() < 5000 event = wait(100, port) if type(event) = "roSocketEvent" changedID = event.getSocketID() if changedID = listener.getID() and listener.isReadable() and accepted = invalid accepted = listener.accept() if accepted <> invalid print "TASK: accepted="; accepted.getID() accepted.setMessagePort(port) accepted.notifyReadable(true) sent = client.sendStr("ping from task") print "TASK: sent="; sent end if else if accepted <> invalid and changedID = accepted.getID() and accepted.isReadable() received = accepted.receiveStr(1024) print "TASK: server received="; received accepted.sendStr("echo: " + received) else if changedID = client.getID() and client.isReadable() result = client.receiveStr(1024) exit while end if end if end while print "TASK: result="; result m.top.content = result ' No Close() calls here on purpose — see source/main.brs. end sub
